_comment: Hologram models. Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py); requires names a capability the model needs to mean anything (it is hidden without it). Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python /usr/lib/bromigos/vector/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview
